findings.title: GKE shared-dir scratchpad rejected standard-rwo StorageClass

findings.title: Upstream GKE Helm chart used ephemeral emptyDir SQLite DB

findings.title: release_builder SA lacked staging bucket IAM for Cloud Build uploads

findings.title: 15-20s Service Usage propagation lag on brand-new GCP projects
findings.resolution: Documented 20s propagation wait after enabling core APIs in deploy/README.md and deploy/ENTERPRISE_PREREQUISITES.md.

findings.title: Upstream cloudbuild-hub-gke.yaml omits logging CLOUD_LOGGING_ONLY
findings.resolution: Documented mandatory --gcs-log-dir flag for custom release_builder SA in ha-gke/README.md and ENTERPRISE_PREREQUISITES.md.

findings.title: Ubuntu cloud-init apt-get update stalled >10m on mirror CLOSE-WAIT
findings.resolution: Added bootcmd /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99-scion-timeouts (30s timeout, 3 retries) before package_update in lite-vm/cloud-init.tftpl.

findings.title: Hardened GKE nodes hit 403 ImagePullBackOff pulling from hub AR
findings.resolution: Provisioned dedicated least-privilege gke_node SA (container.defaultNodeServiceAccount + hub AR reader) when enable_gke_api=true in iam.tf and exported gke_node_sa_email.

findings.title: scion service-accounts --project <slug> cleared hub.project_id in v0.4.0-preview.3
findings.resolution: Updated bootstrap-hub-project.sh to resolve and export SCION_HUB_PROJECT_ID via Hub REST API and omit --project on service-accounts commands.

findings.title: Upstream Scion OIDC member provisioning omitted hub-members group (skill.read denied)
findings.resolution: Logged WK-006 in WORKAROUNDS.yaml (add federated operators to hub-members group) and added oidc_allowed_gcp_projects to lite-vm Terraform.

findings.title: GKE built-in standard-rwx StorageClass hardcoded network=default (fails on custom VPC)
findings.resolution: Exported vpc_name in Stage 01 outputs.tf and documented custom Filestore StorageClass (parameters.network + volumeBindingMode=Immediate) in ha-gke/README.md and ENTERPRISE_PREREQUISITES.md.

findings.title: Antigravity CLI 1.5.14 ADC mode routed Vertex AI via quotaProject (metadata project-id) instead of GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
findings.resolution: Injected GOOGLE_CLOUD_QUOTA_PROJECT=<inference_project_id> in parse_hub_project.py harness rendering and bootstrap-hub-project.sh project env (injectionMode=always), codified in ADR-013.

findings.title: Vertex AI Agent Engine rejected reserved GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT and GOOGLE_CLOUD_QUOTA_PROJECT in deploymentSpec.env
findings.resolution: Fixed in commit 23a1701 (packs/adk/skills/adk-domain-guardrails/SKILL.md, adk-deployer/delta.md, and tests/test_adk_pack_and_ge_export.py).

findings.title: Org policy constraints/iam.disableCrossProjectServiceAccountUsage blocked attaching worker@inf to sbx Agent Engine
findings.resolution: Provisioned same-project adk_runtime@sbx SA (predict-only on inf, AR reader on hub, 0 sbx writes, actAs for deployer) in iam.tf and ADR-013.

findings.title: First cross-project Agent Engine deploy failed (code 13) before gcp-sa-aiplatform-re received hub AR reader
findings.resolution: Documented two-step materialization and enable_agent_engine_re_ar_reader=true in ENTERPRISE_PREREQUISITES.md and deploy/README.md.

findings.title: ADK custom roles omitted discoveryengine.agents.manage and GE agents:create requires active Billing Account GE license
findings.resolution: Added discoveryengine.agents.manage to adkSandboxDeployer and adkSandboxJanitor in iam.tf and documented Billing-level GE license prerequisite in ENTERPRISE_PREREQUISITES.md.

findings.title: ge_payload.py and adk_sandbox_gate.py rejected real numeric GCP project numbers (projects/<num>/...)
findings.resolution: Added explicit --quota-project-number / --sandbox-project-number matching (exported as sandbox_project_number in Stage 01) while keeping cross-project targets fail-closed.

findings.title: Setting container GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION=global on Agent Engine broke regional VertexAiSessionService
findings.resolution: Documented regional container GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION (us-central1) with global model client routing in adk-domain-guardrails/SKILL.md and ENTERPRISE_PREREQUISITES.md.
